company.name: Flock Safety
company.shortDescription: Flock Safety provides end-to-end surveillance solutions to support law enforcement and communities.
company.description: Flock Safety develops security solutions using automated license plate recognition cameras. Its main product is its ALPR cameras, which are used by neighborhoods, law enforcement agencies, and businesses to capture and analyze vehicle license plates. These cameras help in solving and preventing crimes by providing actionable data. The company's platform combines the power of communities at scale, including cities, businesses, schools, and law enforcement agencies – to shape a safer future together. Their full-service, maintenance-free technology solution is trusted by communities to help solve and deter crime in the pursuit of safer communities for everyone.

aiResearchSummary.text: The title Method and system for capturing and storing significant surveillance images and its abstract describe a system with multiple infrared light sources at different wavelengths to enhance image capture. It filters and stores only significant surveillance images, focusing on efficient storage and retrieval of relevant visual data. Flock Safety is researching and developing multi wavelength infrared imaging and selective image storage for improved surveillance capabilities.
